records.title: Open Grounding (Reminders)
records.content:
# First: Protect Sleep and Rest
- Sleep is a priority because it protects healing, regulation, and the ability to act.
- Rest during the day when recovery is the real need; do not fill every open moment.
- Night Time Routine is the wind-down sequence. Sleep is the outcome, not another checkbox.

# Why
- Build a life I can feel and live fully.
- Do the work and make space for love.
- Create an environment that supports the relationships and experiences I need.

# Remember
- Nourishing my body supports energy, strength, skin, hair, and mental health.

# Grounding Lens
- What matters most today?
- Practice patience.
- Reconnect with purpose and direction.
- Make room for joy and curiosity.
- Act with self-assurance.

records.title: Rest & Sleep Priorities
records.content:
REST WHILE AWAKE
Pause before filling every open moment. Choose physical or mental rest when recovery is the real need.

SLEEP
